archiveTitle: Daily Brief | No Rest for the Wicked 1.0 Delayed to March 2027

entries.headline: Turok: Origins preview shows solo campaign and three-player co-op
entries.summary: Xbox Wire's gamescom preview says the campaign can be played solo or with up to three players, and the demo showed the Cougar, Bison, and Raven class roles.
entries.verification: This item only summarizes gameplay directly described in the opened Xbox Wire hands-on article.
entries.timeNote: The article was published at 23:00 Beijing time on September 1, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: No Rest for the Wicked 1.0 delayed to March 2027
entries.summary: IGN and Game Informer report that Moon Studios has moved No Rest for the Wicked 1.0 from October 2026 to March 2027. PC and PS5 are due first, with Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2 still planned for later.
entries.verification: Two independent opened media reports confirm the March 2027 delay.
entries.timeNote: The IGN report was published at 00:10 Beijing time on September 2, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest launches October 23
entries.summary: An IGN interview reveals an October 23, 2026 launch date for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2.
entries.verification: The opened IGN interview explicitly presents the release date and platforms.
entries.timeNote: The interview was published at 00:00 Beijing time on September 2, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Onimusha: Way of the Sword opens at 85 on Metacritic for PS5
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports a Metacritic score of 85 for the PS5 version from more than 80 reviews, while the Nintendo Switch 2 version stood at 89 from six reviews at the time of publication.
entries.verification: This is a time-bounded score snapshot from the opened AUTOMATON report, not a permanent aggregate.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 13:07 Beijing time on September 1, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Monster Hunter Now Osaka event set for November 14–15
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Monster Hunter Now Carnival 2026: Osaka will run November 14–15 around Osaka's Namba area, with first-come ticket sales scheduled to begin at 09:00 on September 3.
entries.verification: Dates, venue area, and ticket timing come from the opened event press-conference report.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 20:24 Beijing time on September 1, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Xbox Game Pass announces its first September wave
entries.summary: IGN's report on Microsoft's first September Game Pass wave lists Shelldiver, SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed, Dice a Million, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, RuneScape: Dragonwilds, and more.
entries.verification: The item is limited to the lineup described in the opened IGN report.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 01:47 Beijing time on September 2, inside the fixed window.

entries.headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 open beta extended
entries.summary: IGN reports that Infinity Ward extended the Modern Warfare 4 open beta to 10 PM PT on September 1, with 2XP and Double Weapon XP staying active through the close.
entries.verification: The extension and bonus-XP details are stated in the opened IGN report quoting Infinity Ward.
entries.timeNote: The report was published at 00:21 Beijing time on September 2, inside the fixed window.
